description:
Kidde helps protect your home and family with trusted smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms, fire extinguishers, and other fire safety products.

Our wide range of solutions all share a common purpose: Helping to protect people and property from the effects of fire and its related hazards.

Kidde is a pioneer in developing fire safety products and has expanded on that legacy to become a world leader in the industry.

Join Kidde on our mission to help families everywhere make fire safety a priority and make every home a safer home at causeforalarm.org and causeforalarm.org/canada
